agentSummary:
The inventory is complete. I did not re-read every call site the area readers recorded. I reviewed the recorded list and checked that the callers of the OpenRouter and Ollama wrappers are covered.

**LLM providers**
- **OpenAI** (`openai` SDK 4.24.7, via `app/api/*`): chat in `chat/openai` and `chat/tools`, `command` (hardcoded `gpt-4-1106-preview`) and `assistants.list`. Embeddings use `text-embedding-3-small` in the three retrieval routes.
- **Azure OpenAI** (same `openai` SDK, with the base URL set to the Azure deployment): chat in `chat/azure` and the Azure branch of the embedding calls. The API version is pinned to `2023-12-01-preview`.
- **Anthropic** (`@anthropic-ai/sdk` 0.18.0): streamed `messages.create`.
- **Google Gemini** (`@google/generative-ai` 0.11.4): streamed `sendMessageStream`.
- **Groq, Mistral, Perplexity, OpenRouter chat** (`openai` SDK, each with its own base URL): one streamed chat call per vendor.
- **Custom model route** (`openai` SDK): the base URL is user-supplied per model row. I recorded it as `custom-openai-compatible`.
- **OpenRouter model list** (raw HTTP): `GET https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models`, called from the browser. It is reached through `fetchOpenRouterModels`, called from `global-state.tsx`, `profile-settings.tsx` and `setup/page.tsx`.
- **Ollama** (raw HTTP to `NEXT_PUBLIC_OLLAMA_URL`): `/api/tags` for the model list and streamed `/api/chat`, both called from the browser.
- **Hugging Face** (`@xenova/transformers` 2.14.0): downloads the `Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2` model for local embeddings on first use. Inference then runs in-process, so I'm unsure whether there is any network use after the first run.

**Supabase**
- **`@supabase/supabase-js` 2.39.3:** about 200 call sites. They cover `db/*` table modules, one RPC, storage uploads, removals and signed URLs, auth in the pages, middleware and `auth/callback`, and the service-role calls in the API routes.
- **`@supabase/ssr` 0.0.10:** the browser client, plus the server helper in `lib/server/server-chat-helpers.ts`. It is recorded as a separate usage because it is a different SDK.
- **Raw HTTP:** six `fetch` calls on Supabase Storage signed URLs, which convert images to base64.

**Vercel**
- **`@vercel/edge-config` 0.4.1:** the login sign-up action reads the email whitelist, only when `EDGE_CONFIG` is set.

**Not recorded or uncertain**
- **User-supplied URLs:** `app/api/chat/tools/route.ts` (lines 153 and 178) fetches URLs taken from user-configured OpenAPI schemas. I did not record these as a provider.
- **Unused dependencies:** `@vercel/analytics`, `@azure/openai` and `@mistralai/mistralai` are in `package.json`, but the readers found no imports of them.
- **Webhooks:** there are no webhook receivers.
- **Internal fetches:** the `fetch` calls to `/api/*` go to the repo's own backend, so they are not external.
